CRITICAL_FINDING: The value 0.35 that the iteration-1/2 papers call 'the published 0.35 separator' of the Jorak scanner DOES NOT APPEAR as a threshold anywhere in the Jorak repository at any commit that touched the classifier. Jorak ships 0.5 for all three weight signals (global u_min alignment, band alignment, bottom-k subspace alignment), calibrated on Qwen2.5-0.5B (censored 0.24 vs abliterated 1.00 global; censored ~0.28 vs abliterated >=0.67 band). The 0.35 is THIS RUN'S OWN pre-registered simulation threshold: iter_1/gen_art/gen_art_experiment_2/flab/config.py line 74 'BSA_PREREG_THRESHOLD: Final[float] = 0.35      # >= flags an edit' under the comment 'Pre-registered SIMULATION thresholds (from the hypothesis-stage simulation)'. The run's BSA_w8 (sliding 8-layer window of MEAN PAIRWISE |cos| between per-layer bottom-1 vectors) is also a different statistic from Jorak's sigma1/||U||_F global alignment and its round(L/6)-window band alignment to a shared axis.
required_paper_correction: Replace 'the published 0.35 separator' with: 'our pre-registered, simulation-calibrated threshold of 0.35 for a Jorak-style bottom-subspace alignment statistic (BSA_w8); the Jorak scanner itself (github.com/JolanMc/Jorak @ 8147de3, modelscanner/classifier/scanner.py L48-55) ships a threshold of 0.5 on differently defined global/band/subspace alignment statistics, calibrated on Qwen2.5-0.5B (censored 0.24 vs abliterated 1.00).' The '100% false-positive rate of a published scanner' claim must be withdrawn or re-run with Jorak's own statistic and 0.5 threshold. Note: honest BSA_w8 = 0.565 also exceeds 0.5, but BSA_w8 is not Jorak's statistic, so no FPR for Jorak can be inferred from it.
